asked.item: Why public comment replies differ each time
How to control the varying replies

verdict.reason: The DM Automations Guide says the public reply card holds several replies and Blotato picks one at random for each comment.

steps.text: The Reply to the comment card turns on with 3 default replies.
Blotato picks one of the replies at random for each comment, so the wording changes from comment to comment.
You can edit the texts in the Reply fields. With more than 3 replies, you can click Remove beside one you do not want.
